label: ercot76 ne import
definition: ERCOT-76 NE-boundary asymmetric import rating on the ercot73-state-wall keeper recipe (zero ScenarioConfig deltas — the change is the iso_configs one-way link pair: NE_LOB export 1,300 MW measured limit-at-bind unchanged; import 1,788 MW = pooled 2023-2025 dark-hour maximum of measured EAST-zone load minus CAMPD NE local gross, the boundary's demonstrated carrying capability). Kills the 2024-05-07 h19/20 invented Northeast VOLL pair for the measured reason (reality imported >= 1,317 MW that evening; a GTC is an export stability limit, never an import rating). Zero fitted scalars (rules 13/14/23/26). Full-span 2023-2025 (rule 16). KEEPER (promoted by the owner 2026-07-17, ercot-76/77/78 close-out session; CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS — the single ledgered caveat is the fully-adjudicated C3c-2024 tail): 2024 invented tail hours 7 -> 5 — the 2024-05-07 h19/20 Northeast VOLL pair dies for the measured reason (caught/missed unchanged); 2023 and 2025 sets and C3 byte-parity; 2024 C3a -3.1 -> -3.2%, C3b 0.143 -> 0.146, C3c 26 -> 24h vs RT 53 — entirely May-2024 -10.3 -> -10.8, the removed phantom exposing the standing May under-pricing (rule-14, the ERCOT-66 pattern); Aug 18-20-2024 guard holds (max 2,859, no shed).
market_story: No class is forced and no offer changes — only the Northeast boundary's import rating becomes physical. ERCOT's NE_LOB constraint is an EXPORT stability limit on the generation-rich NE-Texas lobe (Martin Lake / Tenaska trapped-gen congestion, unchanged at the measured 1,300 MW limit-at-bind); the real grid imports INTO the lobe over the same boundary well above that number whenever the local fleet is on outage — measured at >= 1,317 MW on 2024-05-07 h20 and up to 1,788 MW across 2023-2025 dark hours (EAST-zone load minus CAMPD local gross). The old symmetric bound manufactured phantom Northeast scarcity (VOLL prints with load shed) in real outage seasons; the one-way pair lets the market serve the lobe the way SCED actually does, and the model's remaining prices form on the unchanged offer/reserve structure.
